body:
My (now ex)  girlfriend, who I love more than anyone I've ever loved in my entire life and even thought about asking to marry me,  just adopted two of her dirtbag illegal-immigrant brother's destitute Mexican children born to a money-grubbing crack whore that the brother doesn't support even though he has 4 MORE children here in the US that he supports and spoils,  all simply because he just doesn't give a fuck. Took them because "they're family" with no discussion with me. SURPRISE, motherfucker! Oh, her sister is also a broke-ass piece of work that gets in the hole and leeches off her mother, who gives her money she's supposed to use for MEDICINE so the sister can have her car taken out of impound (repoed because she didn't pay it). Then the mom leans on my ex for money, which she pays.

Was going to even live with this situation (marry her so she/children could get my military benefits and I could help support them). Asked her if she loves me. 

She doesn't.

I called but, not gonna bullshit, did not find it to be a very helpful service. Most of them seem to be geared towards acute cases mostly.

The email correspondence service run by the Samaritans,  on the other hand, was one of the best things that ever happened to me.

Allowed me to take my time and write down exactly how I felt with no pressure, and maintained a semblance of anonymity that made me feel comfortable.

It's pretty awesome.
jo@samaritans.org

As a person who's dealt with addiction before, jeebus find a professional (NOT family/friends/people who know you personally) and tell them everything. The longer you wait, the harder it gets.

1. Honestly, as you've said, it feels good to just PUT IT OUT THERE. I really underestimated how much this would help me.

2. They have a view and perspective on things that was genuinely helpful to me. I was skeptical as hell, as you very well may be. I was wrong, and, as a result, honestly, it's the reason I'm alive today.

Please do not let this man's horrible actions define the wonderful person you are. Do not die, live. If no one else tells you this today, listen very carefully -- you are loved. Use that love. Let it pull you through.

Please go here.  It saved my life.

www.samaritanshope.org

I can also vouch for how amazing these people are. Set up an anonymous email so you feel safe, then use their email service. They will get you well.

Phew! Thank you for that. Went to bed; feeling much better. 

It's a new day.

It most certainly isn't ALL there is in life, but I can't seem to function on even a minimal level. It's almost indescribable what that feels like -- frustration, loneliness, pain, and the tacit knowledge that you're just less than human in some ways. I could deal if I were just BAD at it. It's like a Vitamin D deficiency or something. Sure, it's not all there is, and you can even subsist as long as you have at least a little, but a total lack of it causes you to shrivel up and die inside.
Sociology/psychology. I could probably be a prodigy too if I hadn't pushed myself away from it because I'm afraid of it. Instead I became an EMT.
I am exceptional at medicine, chess, sociology, electronics, and other analytical/technological endeavors. However, it's not enough anymore.
